Build two class/attendance features for **Soul Pilates** (.NET backend + Astro frontend CRM) at /opt/soulpilates on server **51.79.226.200**. LIVE business — ISOLATED branch, compile-verify only, do NOT touch running staging/prod containers or restart anything.

## Access (SAFE method — never print the plaintext password)
ssh2 to .200 via the platform approach (decrypt `server.rootPasswordEnc` for server id `cmsc9l72y000ghl7iyd87u5ja`, never echoed; mirror lib/sftp.ts). ASSERT `hostname -I` contains 51.79.226.200 before EVERY command. Worktree off origin/main (fetch first): `git -C /opt/soulpilates worktree add /opt/soulpilates-wt-class -b feature/class-duo-attendee-qty origin/main`. If classifier-blocked, report.

## Context
View the attachment for card 2: `/opt/nxeon/board-uploads/board/cmskphkyx001thljac9zaci95/7bec2974c133814f5bfed4b5.png` — the class-detail panel ("Hip & Knee Harmony", GROUP, 2/3 booked, attendees list with Arrived/Remove per attendee, and a "+ [1]" add-client control). 

## Understand first
The scheduling/class model + backend `SoulPilates.Services/SchedulingService.cs` and the class-detail panel Astro component (ClassDetailPanel or the schedule pages), how sessions define **capacity** and **private vs group**, and how attendees/bookings occupy spots.

## Feature 1 — Duo private classes backend (card `cmsj1beqn0010hljaw0mcxt0v`)
Currently the backend can't book a **duo private** class — a private session that holds 2 attendees. Add the ability to make a private class a **duo** (capacity 2 for a private-type session) so two clients can be booked into the same private session in the backend. Respect pricing/credit rules per attendee (each attendee books/pays as normal). Don't break existing single private or group classes.

## Feature 2 — Change quantity of existing attendees (card `cmskphkyx001thljac9zaci95`)
On the class-detail panel, add an inline control to **adjust the quantity of an attendee already in the class** (today you can only Remove + re-add). E.g. an attendee booked as 1 should be adjustable to 2 (a client bringing a +1 / booking multiple spots), updating the class's booked count and their booking/credit usage accordingly. Guard against exceeding capacity and against going below 1. Update the "X/Y booked" + spots-remaining correctly.

## Rules & finish
- Compile-verify: `dotnet build` succeeds; Astro frontend builds/type-checks. Do NOT docker build / touch running containers / restart. No Mongo writes (reads only to understand schema).
- Commit to `feature/class-duo-attendee-qty`, push origin (verify push stuck; re-push if reset).
- Board: move BOTH cards to In progress (`cmsavfvin000khla4anofdbxt`) + a "Claude" comment on each (what built, branch, capacity/credit handling, deploy note).
- Report: how duo capacity + per-attendee credit works, how the quantity adjuster updates counts + credits, files changed, dotnet build result, branch tip.

# Stage 1 — restore + publish
FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0 AS build
WORKDIR /src

COPY SoulPilates.slnx ./

    -c Release \
    -o /app/publish \
    --no-restore \

Built both class/attendance features for Soul Pilates on the LIVE .200 box using an isolated worktree off `origin/main` — compile-verify only, no running container/DB touched, no restart.

**Branch:** `feature/class-duo-attendee-qty` — tip `5d4e9b4`, pushed to origin and verified stuck (remote == local).

### Feature 1 — Duo private classes backend (card cmsj1beqn…)
The public path (`ReserveSpotAsync`) already handled a single-booker duo. The real gap was the **backend/desk path**: `AdminAddStudentAsync` clamped a private add to 2 seats but a PRIVATE session has `Capacity=1`, so a 2nd distinct client was rejected as "full". Fix:
- `AdminAddStudentAsync` now, for a PRIVATE session, caps the class at 2 seats total and **lifts `Capacity` 1→2** when needed (mirroring the existing SPM-98 duo rule in `ReserveSpotAsync`). Two clients now fit — one booker ×2, or two distinct clients ×1 each. A 3rd seat is still rejected via the atomic `TryClaimSessionCapacity` guard.
- **Per-attendee credit:** unchanged — each attendee is its own `Attendance` and books/pays per seat (per-seat drop-in or per-seat package credit on check-in/collect). No shared duo pricing.
- `RemoveAttendanceAsync` now calls `RestorePrivateCapacityIfEmptyAsync`, so an emptied duo private reverts to `Capacity 1` and can't be double-booked by two unrelated singles. Single-private and group classes are untouched.

### Feature 2 — Adjust quantity of existing attendees (card cmskphkyx…)
- New `AdjustAttendeeQuantityAsync` + `PATCH /api/scheduling/session/{id}/attendee/{attendanceId}/quantity` + an inline **`− [n seats] +` stepper** on every class-detail roster row.
- **Counts:** grow/shrink atomically claims/releases only the seat *delta*, keeping `CurrentBookings` (the "X/Y booked" count) and spots-remaining correct; the panel does a full refresh so header + roster update in place.
- **Credit/charge:** PACKAGE_CREDIT **debits** the delta on grow (rolled back if the wallet can't cover it via `DeductCreditAsync`) and **partially refunds** on shrink (`RefundPartialCreditByAttendanceWithTrailAsync`); pay-at-studio re-snapshots amount-due = drop-in × new qty.
- **Guards:** minimum 1 seat, PRIVATE duo cap of 2 (bumps a 1-on-1 to Capacity 2), remaining capacity; refuses already cash/card-paid rows and bring-a-friend rows (same precedent as `SplitBookingAsync`).
